# PDF.js 6.4.299

Mozilla PDF.js generic viewer, from the official release distribution.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299
Archive: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/download/v6.4.299/pdfjs-6.4.299-dist.zip
Archive SHA-256: f2245eb7ef3f674c872fe568a177bfec15874f5c034613e55d8e307f93ebd86d

Runtime files are unmodified. Source maps and the example PDF are omitted.
The viewer, worker, fonts, CMaps, localization and WASM assets are served locally.
See LICENSE and the resource directories for third-party notices.
